static.prompt:
A cherub from Valentine's Day Town is wooing a Halloween Town witch. "Your werewolf boyfriend is too predictable," he explains.
"Watch how he prowls over every inch of the town square. Whenever he sees a full moon, he turns. And you know he'll turn once again before the next full moon. He winds up back where he started, stuck in a rut."
With a sly grin, the cherub adds, "Ever consider dating someone like me?" What can the werewolf say to save his relationship?
